programme.title: Max Havoc: Ring of Fire
programme.desc: Max Havoc is on a new assignment staying at a luxury hotel in the heart of a big city only to discover that the classy hotel owner is a vicious mob boss heading up a crime ring full of unwanted teenagers in the nearby slums.

programme.title: Last Chance Cafe
programme.desc: After uncovering evidence that her stepfather was murdered by a ring of corrupt cops and judges, including her DA ex-husband, a woman is forced to flee with her daughter and hide in a small farming town, where she falls for a local ranch owner but danger soon follows.

programme.title: Max Havoc: Curse of the Dragon
programme.desc: Exotic action/adventure and martial arts blend together as Max Havoc, world famous kickboxer turned sports photographer, faces the relentless Black Dragons in a reluctant quest to save the lovely Goody sisters and to avenge the death of good friend Tahsi in Guam.

programme.title: Criminal Intent
programme.desc: Devon thought that his share of difficulties were over after a difficult divorce but on the road to rebuilding his life, tragedy strikes leaving him in a fight for his freedom and his innocence.

programme.title: Double Cross
programme.desc: Kathy Swanson and her neighbor, Sheryl, are both having difficulty with their husbands. So when Sheryl suggests to Kathy that they should get their lives back by killing each other’s husbands, Kathy facetiously sanctions the plan.

programme.title: Captive Hearts
programme.desc: A finance executive is mysteriously kidnapped and when the hostage takers send video demands directly to the man’s wife, a lone police officer, Detective Kelsoe, has his suspicions.

programme.title: 12 Hours to Live
programme.desc: 18 year old Amy is kidnapped by a deranged gunman wanted for the murder of an FBI Agent and FBI Agent Megan is hot on his trail. When it's learned that Amy is a type-1 diabetic, Megan must once again confront the man who violently killed her partner to save Amy.

programme.title: Universal Soldier II: Brothers in Arms
programme.desc: Luc and Veronica recover and revive Luc's long-lost brother who has been suspended in a cryo-chamber for decades and attempt to expose the Unisol program, led by Mazur (Gary Busey), which recycles dead soldiers in the attempt to create the ultimate mercenary army.

programme.desc: Veronica and Luc conclude their quest to expose the Unisol program to the media and destroy Mentor's (Burt Reynolds) billion dollar heist, while the evil Dr. Walker creates a genetically engineered Unisol GR87, programmed with the single mission to destroy Luc and Veronica.

programme.title: Marker
programme.desc: In an isolated small town in the Pacific Northwest, Sylvia's teenaged life of juggling two boyfriends and an overprotective father is turned upside down when she discovers she has a bizarre virus which has randomly plagued the women in her community for decades and shamefully forced those afflicted into hiding. Sylvia undergoes a horrifying physical transformation, and she finds herself drawn into a persecuted underworld where she begins an astonishing journey of freakish self-discovery. Marker is a classic coming-of-age tale with a horror twist, which pits its heroine against her oppressors - the town's non-afflicted - in a battle for self-determination--and survival.

programme.title: Goatman
programme.desc: A news reporter and her crew investigating the legend of "Goatman" in a dense forest find themselves in danger, getting a bigger story than any of them could imagine...

programme.title: Demonic Plastic Surgeon, MD
programme.desc: At an elderly peoples home, a demonic plastic surgeon has been summoned. And soon, they will all be due a make over...

programme.title: Python Island
programme.desc: A group of people searching for a magical tree in a mysterious jungle, find they are not alone. Something is watching them, waiting for the perfect moment to strike...

programme.title: Ouija Deadly Reunion
programme.desc: Strange happenings occur to some friends before a birthday party in a large warehouse. Two of them find an old spirit board and they decide to contact the dead victim former tenants...

programme.title: Dead End Demon (aka Dead End 2)
programme.desc: It has been almost 2 years since the small town of Santa Carla had suffered in the hands of the raging maniac, Cameron Crowe. Legend around town had it as that he may have been burnt in a fire he started...

programme.title: Dinosaur Hotel 2
programme.desc: Surviving contestants are reunited in the ultimate game to win 10 million dollars. Only one contestant will survive and claim the prize as the others fall to the dinosaurs...

programme.title: The Leprechaun's Game
programme.desc: After a bunch of thieves are sent out to hunt for urban legends by a wealthy man intending to open a museum full of mythical creatures. Soon, the thieves will learn the legend of a Leprechaun...

programme.title: The Body Tree
programme.desc: When a group of Americans travels to Russian Siberia to honor the memory of their murdered friend, they uncover a plot that threatens all their lives...

programme.title: Scarecrow's Revenge
programme.desc: A Viking Warrioress must step up when a heathen, banished from her village gives up his mortal soul in exchange for the near indestructible form of a demonic Scarecrow. As warriors fall to the vengeful Scarecrow, it's down to Greta to save her village from annihilation...

programme.title: Shutter
programme.desc: A supernatural stalker pursues a super model to steal her soul with his demonic camera...

programme.title: The Mermaid's Curse
programme.desc: A young man falls in love with a seductive, sultry, young woman he meets on the beach. The more he falls for her, the more he will learn the dangers of falling in love with a siren...

programme.title: Ditch Day
programme.desc: Jenny Bilson, a high school senior, is the perfect student, a wonderful daughter to a veteran police detective and an all American Dream. But the one mistake she is unaware of making is about to haunt her in a very violent way, as her past returns for revenge...

programme.title: American Beast (aka Beast of Prey)
programme.desc: After finding an old storage locker filled with his family's history, James Erikson begins a journey to discover the truth behind a mysterious piece of land in the small town of Solitude...

programme.title: Die In One Day
programme.desc: After a failed marriage, Richard is in search of his daughter Mindy. He meets Sasha, an aspiring actress who promises to help him. But the hope to get some quick cash by performing in a 24 hours play soon turns out to be a bloody game...

programme.title: The Midnight Man
programme.desc: Hoping to fix their dysfunctional marriage, a couple travels to an isolated mountain cabin to work out their problems - but the one problem they didn't anticipate is the maniac trying to kill them...

programme.title: Alp
programme.desc: After a traumatic experience, Chris comes home to confront his past. but soon finds himself prey to a Demon who taunts him through sleep paralysis...

programme.title: Camp Massacre
programme.desc: Ten obese men appear on a competitive reality show geared toward weight-loss. As contestants disappear in the night it becomes apparent that a killer is on the loose...

programme.title: Creature in the Dark
programme.desc: After strange creatures arrive, a husband waiting for the return of his wife, must adjust to being sole caretaker of his young daughter, while dealing with what is in his basement...

programme.title: Baby Doll
programme.desc: A group of student in vacation find themselves in a house where strange rituals were performed. The sudden finding of a doll bring the group on a downward spiral...

programme.title: Blue Hour
programme.desc: Olivia Brandreth was nine years old when her father disappeared. Twenty five years later, she has returned to her childhood home to finally get closure in an unrelenting attempt to set the record straight...

programme.title: The Elevator (ITN)
programme.desc: A reporter discovers all is not as it seems at an infamous hotel...

programme.title: Horror High 2020 Tyler J. Case
programme.desc: A monster lurks around a high school in the hypnotized town of Willow Hills and picks off tardy students one by one. Now it is up to an unlikely group of teens to put an end to the terror that has plagued many...

programme.title: Lake Terror
programme.desc: Remington has escaped the evil cabin but now the evil continues to follow him, wreaking havoc wherever he goes. Meanwhile, Chloe and Revel look for a missing sister that went to the evil cabin in the previous installment. The two meet Vincent, a failing TV host, to help psychically contact the missing sister. That's when a gunshot rings out in the night and the three meet Remington. Now they all must battle for their lives against the evil that pursues Remington to once and for all lock the evil away for good...

programme.title: Jack and Jill: The Hills of Hell
programme.desc: After searching for her missing daughter, a lady and her search party discover the legend behind the murderous pair of Jack and Jill...

programme.title: Village of the Vampire
programme.desc: Rebecca is searching for her sister, a young journalist who went missing while investigating a series of unfortunate events. The trail leads her to Timere, a remote place far from the hustle and bustle of everyday life, where amidst the tight lipped silence of the town's inhabitants there's an ever growing fear of dark forces at work and no-one dares to leave their home at night. Here Rebecca meets an extravagant writer, the church warden of the town and above all Caleb, a charming, rich and elegant man whose dark gaze hides a chilling secret. It's in this town, where time appears to move between the shadows and danger lurks around every corner that Rebecca learns of the terrible truth and the battle between good and evil begins...

programme.title: Clown Motel
programme.desc: Clown Motel follows a group of ghost hunters, coming from an old ghost town and a bachelorette party, returning home from Las Vegas. When the groups meet up, by mistake, they're left to discover if the motel is really abandoned and haunted by the souls, of the clowns, that once lived there...

programme.title: Mi Sangriento Cumpleaños
programme.desc: Tras un terrible trauma en su cumpleaños, Emma decide no volver a celebrarlo. Pero al cumplir 21, una amiga rompe el ritual con una fiesta sorpresa, sin percatarse del despertar de los horrores que durante años han estado acechando en la oscuridad...

programme.title: La Feria del Diablo
programme.desc: Protagonizada por Justin Duncan, Gerald Crum, Mercedes Peterson y John Charles Dickson. Las estrellas de dos series de televisión paranormales, rivales y enfrentadas, convergen en un parque de atracciones embrujado y abandonado que termina siendo el epicentro del infierno. Ahora están todos atrapados en una guerra sin cuartel contra el mal puro...

programme.title: Naufragio
programme.desc: Mientras transportaba un paquete importante, una joven sufre un accidente de coche en medio de la nada, dejándola atrapada debajo del coche. Poco a poco, se da cuenta de que no solo unos hombres muy malvados la persiguen para recuperar el objeto que transporta, sino que algo muy peligroso la acecha desde las profundidades del bosque...

programme.title: El Juego del Duende
programme.desc: Después de que un hombre adinerado envía a un grupo de ladrones a buscar leyendas urbanas con la intención de abrir un museo lleno de criaturas míticas, pronto descubrirán la leyenda de un duende...

programme.title: Verano Sangriento
programme.desc: Cuatro jóvenes llegan a Mallorca para disfrutar de unas idílicas vacaciones de verano, pero adentrándose en los lugares más inhóspitos de la isla comenzarán un viaje infernal...

programme.title: Juicios de Brujas
programme.desc: Dos realizadores de documentales y un ex policía investigan la desaparición de una niña que se rumorea que fue secuestrada por una bruja en los bosques encantados de Connecticut...

programme.title: Habitación Ouija
programme.desc: Una mujer agorafóbica con autismo comienza a invocar espíritus para que sean sus amigos mientras su hermano/cuidador está ausente durante el día, pero cuanto más tiempo pasa con los espíritus, más claro se vuelve que no son tan amigables después de todo...

programme.title: Serpiente
programme.desc: El equipo de construcción desarrolló a ciegas la isla desconocida, lo que alertó a las dos feroces criaturas de la isla para que fueran destruidas...

programme.title: Recuérdame
programme.desc: Rose despierta en una casa desconocida tras un grave accidente de coche, con pérdida de memoria y sin poder caminar. Su madre y su novio están allí para ayudarla. Rose quiere reconstruir su vida antes del accidente. No todo es lo que parece...

programme.title: La Maldición de la Sirena
programme.desc: Un joven se enamora de una joven seductora y sensual que conoce en la playa. Cuanto más se enamora de ella, más aprende los peligros de enamorarse de una sirena...

programme.title: Aldea del Vampiro
programme.desc: Rebecca busca a su hermana, una joven periodista desaparecida mientras investigaba una serie de desafortunados sucesos. El rastro la conduce a Timere, un lugar remoto alejado del ajetreo de la vida cotidiana, donde entre el hermético silencio de los habitantes del pueblo crece el temor a que actúen fuerzas oscuras y nadie se atreve a salir de casa por la noche. Aquí Rebecca conoce a un extravagante escritor, al guardián de la iglesia del pueblo y, sobre todo, a Caleb, un hombre encantador, rico y elegante cuya oscura mirada esconde un escalofriante secreto. Es en este pueblo, donde el tiempo parece moverse entre las sombras y el peligro acecha en cada esquina, donde Rebecca se entera de la terrible verdad y comienza la batalla entre el bien y el mal...

programme.title: Día del Abandono
programme.desc: Jenny Bilson, una estudiante de último curso de instituto, es la estudiante perfecta, la maravillosa hija de un veterano detective de policía y todo un sueño americano. Pero el único error que no es consciente de haber cometido está a punto de perseguirla de una forma muy violenta, cuando su pasado regresa en busca de venganza...

programme.title: Isla Pitón
programme.desc: Un grupo de personas que buscan un árbol mágico en una selva misteriosa descubren que no están solos. Algo los observa, esperando el momento perfecto para atacar...

programme.title: Jack y Jill: Las Colinas del Infierno
programme.desc: Tras buscar a su hija desaparecida, una dama y su grupo de búsqueda descubren la leyenda que se esconde tras la pareja asesina de Jack y Jill...

programme.title: Ouija: Reunión Mortal
programme.desc: Sucesos extraños les ocurren a unos amigos antes de una fiesta de cumpleaños en un gran almacén. Dos de ellos encuentran un viejo tablero de espiritismo y deciden contactar con los antiguos inquilinos de la víctima fallecida...

programme.title: El Resurgir de la Momia
programme.desc: Un grupo de estudiantes de arqueología despierta a una momia ancestral. Tras quedar atrapados en un bucle temporal, la única forma de escapar es derrotarla. A medida que aumenta el número de cadáveres, parece que la Momia debe recolectar las almas de quienes la despertaron para poder caminar sobre la tierra, para siempre...

programme.title: Jack y Jill 3
programme.desc: 10 años después de los últimos asesinatos atroces en la colina, Jack y Jill están de regreso para masacrar al elenco y al equipo de un programa de Internet en vivo que busca descubrir los secretos de la leyenda...

programme.title: El Demonio Interior
programme.desc: Años después de salir de la cárcel, Sam Parsons intenta rehacer su vida con su mujer Courtney y su hija Harper. Trabaja duro para mantener a su familia y permitirse una bonita casa en su tranquilo barrio de las afueras. Cuando empiezan a ocurrir sucesos sobrenaturales en la casa, Sam teme por la seguridad de su mujer y su hija. Cuando los sucesos se convierten en ataques, Sam contrata a Corbin Carlysle y a su equipo de cazafantasmas conocido como «The Ghost Killers», para que le ayuden a luchar contra la entidad oscura que acecha en las sombras de su casa. Cuando las cosas empiezan a complicarse y queda claro que esta entidad es mucho más peligrosa que el típico fantasma, surgen complicaciones cuando Corbin y su equipo se centran más en la fama y la fortuna. Para ganar esta lucha Sam debe luchar contra sus propios demonios interiores y volver a su violento pasado. Para salvar a sus seres queridos, un Demonio debe enfrentarse a un Demonio.

programme.title: Portal de Monstruos de H.P. Lovecraft
programme.desc: Una secta está a punto de despertar a la criatura más temida de H.P. Lovecraft...

programme.title: Predicción Fatal
programme.desc: Una lectura de tarot parece señalar a Manuel como el que causará la muerte de Acrisio, un político sin escrúpulos que es el padre de Danna, la novia de este joven.

programme.title: El Testigo Del Diablo
programme.desc: Cuando una seductora reina vampira decide que es hora de sentar cabeza, limita su búsqueda a cinco candidatos desprevenidos y los atrae a su mansión.

programme.title: El Beso Inmortal: La Reina De La Noche
programme.desc: Las vacaciones italianas de dos universitarias chocan con un antiguo ritual. Pero a veces los rezos se convierten en cazadores.

programme.title: La Leyenda De La Deseada
programme.desc: Recién llegada a Villaldama, Lizzy, apodada "La Deseada" por su belleza, se enamora de Fernando, un joven humilde.

programme.title: La Guarida De Los Payasos Asesinos
programme.desc: Dos policías investigan un espeluznante refugio vacío para personas sin hogar con un laberinto interminable de espacios y son atacados por zombis.

programme.title: 1962 La Masacre de Hallowen
programme.desc: En 1969, el FBI encontró una máscara que perteneció al asesino en serie que mató a 7 personas durante una fiesta de disfraces la noche de Halloween de 1972.

programme.title: En Un Lugar De La Mancha
programme.desc: En una pequeña localidad de La Mancha, Isabel y Silvia, cansadas de esconder su pasión, deciden marcharse un fin de semana a la casa rural que alquila el sacerdote de un pueblo cercano. Pronto lamentarán su decisión.

programme.title: El Expediente Belchite
programme.desc: El expediente Belchite no es solamente una historia de miedo; como toda narración que nos habla de una trascendencia más allá de vida terrena, la película plantea interrogantes sobre la finitud, o no, de eso que algunos llaman alma.

programme.title: Después Del Azul
programme.desc: Fausto se electrocuta y queda en coma, sobrevive con la realidad alterada, escucha a la soledad y ve varias mujeres que le representan la muerte.

programme.title: La Llaman Cazadora de Cabezas
programme.desc: Después de escapar de un refugio para personas sin hogar infestado de carnívoros zombis, ambos policías descubren que el mundo entero ahora está sumido en el caos.

programme.title: Lucero
programme.desc: Claustrofóbica, demente y puntualmente burlona, “Lucero” no sólo es una perla del fantástico de trinchera sino la enésima prueba de la capacidad de su director para, sin apenas medios y desde los márgenes de una industria fílmica como la española actual rendida al gusto indiferenciado y a la mentalidad de cadena de montaje, generar obras sugestivas, disconformes y estridentes en el mejor sentido.

programme.title: Toda La Noche
programme.desc: Una pareja argentina en una fiesta en el campo se encuentra con que están matando a sus amigos.

programme.title: La Otra Palabra
programme.desc: Película documental que se adentra a lo más profundo de las prácticas esotéricas más antiguas. ¿Qué es la magia? ¿Es jugar con el diablo?

programme.title: Morirse En Domingo
programme.desc: Julio Salas muere tras una larga enfermedad, pero es domingo y su familia por dificultades económicas se ve forzada a contratar los servicios de una modesta agencia funeraria.

programme.title: El Secreto Oculto
programme.desc: Describe los eventos del fin de los tiempos de la humanidad profetizada por místicos y Santos sobre los 3 días de oscuridad en que los demonios serán soldados ...

programme.title: The Juniors y La Formula Imperial
programme.desc: Narra las vidas de 7 adolescentes millonarios que se aventuran a planificar una revolución social, generada por vídeo-escándalos y experimentos médicos, con el objetivo de generar un cambio en la ideología mundial, el conflicto entre las clases sociales y el enfrentamiento con sus muchachas de servicio doméstico.

programme.title: Hienas
programme.desc: Luis ha metido la pata... hasta el fondo. Pero Pepe está ahí para ayudarlo... a caer. Ninguno de los dos tenía idea del grandísimo lío en el que andaban metidos ya desde hacía tiempo. Una liada de cojones.

programme.title: Reto Sangriento
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes investigadores de fenómenos paranormales reciben el reto de pasar un fin de semana en una casa donde habitan seres malignos. Esto con el fin de presentar las evidencias en su programa de televisión y levantar el rating, pero lo que no saben es que el reto les costara muy caro.

programme.title: Mi Pequeña Pesadilla
programme.desc: Después de la terrible experiencia y la pérdida de sus amigos, Heather se ve obligada a regresar al Hotel Fear donde Travis se prepara para sus próximas víctimas.

programme.desc: A mysterious mountain in the heart of Arizona is rumored to be a hub of cosmic knowledge. Two locals investigate the truth hidden within.

programme.title: A Mothers Heartbreak
programme.desc: In Dixon, California, four children wake up one morning to find their mother missing. They turn to their uncle, a seasoned detective, for help. The case quickly dead-ends, but the detective can't quit until he's tried every tool in his investigative arsenal - including forensic psychic Sally Headding. A New Jersey mother wins custody of her three children only to have her ex-husband abduct them and flee. With the help of a detective and psychic Nancy Orlen Weber, she tracks them across the country, but the ex-husband is always one step ahead - putting Nancy's visions to the test.

programme.title: Scary Videos You Should NOT Watch At Midnight
programme.desc: Analysis and presentations of scary videos featuring ghosts, creatures and other mysterious subjects.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked S01E01
programme.desc: Enter a world where craftsmanship meets art at a microscopic level. For the first time ever, high-definition cameras equipped with super-macro lenses reveal the inner workings of some of the most delicate and exquisite timepieces ever created. Two-thousand-year-old-bones may be evidence, never before seen, of an actual crucifixion from the time of Jesus. They may reveal that the classic depiction of Jesus on the cross is not how crucifixions were actually carried out in the 1st Century.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked S01E02
programme.desc: A recently discovered Dead Sea Scrolls fragment may be the oldest reference to Jesus ever found. It may have been written in Aramaic by some of his earliest disciples. Outside the ancient city of Jericho there is evidence that the same Roman Army that oppressed Christians may have been secretly worshipping Jesus.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked S01E03
programme.desc: The eruption of Vesuvius may have been the catalyst for the spread of Christianity in the Roman Empire. Have archeologists found the earliest reference to "Christians" in Pompeii? How did our current alphabet evolve? Perhaps from adaptations of Egyptian hierogylphics? How did the symbols become associated with sounds? Travel from Toronto to Serabit El Kadim in Egypt as we look for answers to how we got to our 26 letter alphabet.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked S01E04
programme.desc: There are literally hundreds of food references in the Bible, but the Bible lists ingredients - not recipes. Learn how to make olive oil as they did in ancient times and find out more about the meat, grains and beans eaten in biblical times and how they were prepared. There is new evidence to suggest that the cross was used as a symbol of Christianity far earlier than the time of Constantine. Excavations in Herculaneum and Bethsaida tell a new story about the adoption of the cross as a representation of faith.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked S01E05
programme.desc: Around 733 B.C., ten of the twelve tribes of Israel were conquered and exiled by the Assyrian Empire. Where did the Gadarenes of Gadara go when they were exiled? Can we trace them through to the 21st Century in Europe? Is there any archeological proof for the tradition that Christ carried his cross and stopped in certain locations on the way to Calvary? We follow The Stations Of The Cross to find out what traces may remain in present-day Jerusalem.

programme.title: Aliens Uncovered: The Land of Legends Part 2
programme.desc: In the deserts of Arizona, beneath the vast expanse of the night sky, unseen forces linger, defying explanation and challenging our perception of reality. Journey through time as we explore encounters from Native American folklore to modern sightings, uncovering tales of mysterious crafts, otherworldly beings, and government cover-ups. As we traverse the stunning landscapes of Arizona, we reveal how these legends have shaped a collective fascination with the skies, inviting viewers to ponder: are we truly alone in the universe?

programme.title: Shopping Spree Killer
programme.desc: An 86-year-old woman is stabbed and strangled in her home, within the secure walls of the upscale gated community of Canyon Lake, California. Before the body is cold, another elderly woman is brutally slain. Investigators can’t find a motive, and the violence against the frail victims is so shockingly over-the-top, they fear there’s a psychopathic serial killer on the loose. While the community cowers in fear, and people move their elderly parents out of Canyon Lake, police race to stop the killer in time. In their investigation, they dig deep for the scanty forensic evidence, befriend potential suspects, and are appalled by a callous post-kill ritual that becomes the murderer’s trademark.

programme.desc: Ben is the founder of outdoor pop-up concept WEDriveIns, which repurposes disused urban parking lots as drive-in movie theaters. City officials have been gratifyingly swift to support the project which provides Covid safe entertainment and brings customers to shopping areas. So why cant Ben scale? Well, he needs the permission of the movie studios to use the technology to get him there. And, they aint budging. Can Marc and Mitch help Ben break through the analogue approach?

programme.title: Has Anybody Not Seen That Product?
programme.desc: Hopeful contestants may think their ideas are fresh and exciting, but more than half will fall short of the investors standards. From 21st-century photo booths to a line of lingerie, some judges will invest, but others will leave them puzzled or unconvinced.

programme.title: Casual Geographic’s Guide to Making Content People Actually Watch

programme.title: The Forbidden Love Every Founder Feels with Jason Feifer
programme.desc: Raj Mehra shares how listening to users forced him to rethink his original idea and transform Sage Healthcare into a different company.

programme.title: Music Mogul DJ Khaled Drops Business & Life Keys
programme.desc: DJ Khaled is a world renowned record producer, DJ, record label executive and entrepreneur. The larger-than-life music producer and DJ is known for working with A-list talent such as Jay-Z, Beyonc, Lil Wayne and Nicki Minaj and producing platinum hits. On this exclusive episode, Khaled shares his keys to social media, talks about performing at the Grammys with Rhianna, and shares about his friendship with JayZ.

programme.title: How To Increase Product Sales Through Community With Lamar Tyler
programme.desc: Lamar Tyler is back, discussing building community, sales, customer retention, and surrounding yourself with winners. He's passionate about reshaping the face of entrepreneurship in the African American community and helping entrepreneurs grow their businesses. His advice? Before getting a coach, its good to do your research first.

programme.title: You Attacked Me!
programme.desc: The four women founders who appear in this episode have created a wide range of products and services in the childcare, wedding, fashion and music industries. Two of the four founders manage to convince the judges to open the elevator doors.

programme.title: The CEOs of Orzinga, & Grubhub

programme.title: The CEOs of Hallow, & Decasonic
programme.desc: Introducing Alex Jones, CEO of Hallow, the #1 Christian prayer app, offering audio-guided meditation for spiritual growth. Also, meet Paul Hsu, CEO of Decasonic, a venture and digital assets fund, with experience at Zynga and as a founding member of NeoCarta.

programme.title: Flying Cars, Holographic Food, & Autonomous Firefighters
programme.desc: Meet Dr. Rafi Yoeli, who spent the last 30 years designing Flying Cars, Taxis & Rescue Vehicles. Also, see Holographic food menus, ordering, and drones that fly into burning buildings to warn the Fire Fighters before they venture in and risk their lives.

programme.title: Attack of the Drones, Planes, & Car Hackings
programme.desc: Drones have become increasingly popular but pose a significant security threat. Meet the inventors of intelligent 360-degree drone defense systems worth millions of dollars. We also visit an aeronautics technology fund, enhancing our air travel, and watch Jonnys connected car get hacked and taken over by a trained cybersecurity expert!

programme.title: So Paulo
programme.desc: Welcome to 'Meet the Drapers' So Paulo edition! Tim Draper, alongside guest judges Renato Abissamra, Filipe Trindade, and Alan Fernandes, explores billion-dollar potential in startups Peoplefy, Getter, Lize.ai, and Foodz. Who from So Paulo will advance to the semi-finals, and which startup will win hearts to stay in the competition? Don't miss the excitement of innovation and investment!

programme.title: Can a Product Aimed at Classrooms Turn a Profit? Part 1
programme.desc: How many times have you been told that will never work? Probably not as often as Netflix co-founder Marc Randolph. The Silicon Valley entrepreneur, advisor, investor, speaker, and best-selling author has founded/co-founded half-a-dozen successful startups and mentored scores of entrepreneurs. Be a fly on the boardroom wall as Marc's podcast opens up the opportunity for entrepreneurs everywhere to gain the benefit of his years of experience as he helps each guest think through their business problems.

programme.title: How To Sustain High Performance - Sami Inkinen of Virta Health
programme.desc: Sami Inkinen shares how a health scare changed his approach to entrepreneurship and led him to build Virta Health around the idea of sustainable high performance.

programme.title: Meshuggah Bagels
programme.desc: Unable to find NY-style bagels in KC, The Linde's would lug bagels from NY back to MI for years. So they quit their jobs and turned their love of bagels into a business. Meshuggah Bagels has 4 locations and uses Kosher methods for traditional NY bagels.

programme.title: Level Up On IG Reels W/ Afnan Idris
programme.desc: If you understand your audience, you can monetize your IG Reels. Afnan Idris talks about Instagram Reels and how to grab attention and monetize them. Many influencers are gaining high viewership rates through IG Reels, and its critical that you understand your audience. People are waiting to hear your story, so grab attention and be relatable.

programme.title: What It Takes To Build A Successful Podcast w/ Shawn Anthony
programme.desc: Today Mario discusses all things podcasting with Shawn Anthony, the creator of School's Over...Now What? and Podcast Secrets Revealed. It takes a lot of hard work and patience to build and monetize your podcast. Yes, you want to monetize quickly but take some time to build authenticity and uniqueness. Ultimately, that will be your superpower.

programme.title: Music Mogul DJ Khaled Drops Business & Life Keys
programme.desc: DJ Khaled is a world renowned record producer, DJ, record label executive and entrepreneur. The larger-than-life music producer and DJ is known for working with A-list talent such as Jay-Z, Beyonc, Lil Wayne and Nicki Minaj and producing platinum hits. On this exclusive episode, Khaled shares his keys to social media, talks about performing at the Grammys with Rhianna, and shares about his friendship with JayZ.

programme.title: Hip Hop Legend Damon Dash Explains How His Street Mentality Catapulted Him to the Top
programme.desc: Damon Dash not only solidified himself as a music mogul but grew Rocawear into a top streetwear company that sold for a reported $204 million. Damon later opened DD172, an art gallery and creative collective in New York City, in addition to founding Creative Control -- a digital media platform that explored the intersection of music, art and culture. His portfolio of ventures also includes a spirits company, another clothing company and Dame Dash Studios. And, he's releasing a new film called Honor Up which was executive produced by Kanye and scheduled for release this year.

programme.title: Did This Entrepreneur Just Abort His Own Mission?
programme.desc: This episodes entrepreneurs present cigars, skincare products, cookie dough, and more. Meanwhile, this weeks investors, find themselves conflicted about everything from health benefits to valuations.

programme.title: Can Mushrooms Save the World?
programme.desc: On this episode of Entrepreneur Elevator Pitch, founders face the dilemma of choosing one investor among many. They weigh financial backing against mentoring opportunities. Investors scrutinize pitches, assess agri-tech startup founder's business savvy.

programme.title: Is His Business About to Gobble Up Uber Eats and DoorDash?
programme.desc: In the season nine finale of Entrepreneur Elevator Pitch, Marc Randolph advises against pitching the wrong person. Contestants vie for life-changing deals in just 60 seconds, some succeeding while others fall short.

With anticipation running high, witness the thrilling journey of these startups as they vie for recognition and a chance to make it to the grand finale.

programme.desc: Bill Copeland is a US Army vet and Master Chocolatier. He opened Glacier Confection, inspired by Major Dan Rooney, to help veterans especially those who have PTSD. Teaching chocolate-making 101 classes, and donating a portion of every sale to veterans.

programme.title: Can a Saliva Test Tell You Whether He's the One?
programme.desc: Entrepreneurs pitch their solutions to various problems, from finding love to staying hydrated in bed. Plus, an all-in-one picture-hanging tool tries to level up the boardroom.

programme.title: Want a Job, a Baby or Some New Friends?
programme.desc: From new social networking apps to fertility trackers and a company using AI to recruit for businesses, episode three is packed with ideas to improve people's lives. Still, not all entrepreneurs behind these solutions will get to step through the elevator doors.

Find out which startup moves to the semi-finals!

His site Fleur.ai seeks to disrupt and democratize the art world. But its been tough. Its an idea he and his co-founders passionately believe the world needs but its also a pitch that Marcs heard a few times before. So what makes Fleur different? Have they got enough data to prove their premise?

Be a fly on the boardroom wall as Marc's podcast opens up the opportunity for entrepreneurs everywhere to gain the benefit of his years of experience as he helps each guest think through their business problems. How do you support entrepreneurial spirit in your child? Thats what Marc explores in this weeks episode with the help of the first ever quartet of co-founders to appear on the show. Elementary schoolers Julianne, Zachary, Maxfield and Mark have created beverage brand Astronade and caught Marcs attention with their plucky marketing plan that even wound in their local mayor.

programme.desc: Jordan DeCicco created Super Coffee in his dorm room when he was only 19 years old. He dropped out of college to go full-time on his side-hustle and now, together with his two brothers runs the bottled beverage brand out of Austin, Texas. With an impressive $125m in annual revenue, the DeCiccos have attracted big name investors including J. Lo and Alex Rodriguez. Their next step is tackling how to scale - not just domestically but also internationally.

programme.title: Profitability Tips With Lamar Tyler
programme.desc: Lamar Tyler gives incredibly valuable tips on how to increase profit in business. These are tips that can genuinely change your business for the better. Focus on the customers that you already have. How can you increase the average amount they spend, and increase their customer lifetime value? Too many entrepreneurs go after new customers rather than retaining old ones.

Dr. Snyder’s primary focus is working leaders of leaders. In doing so, she encounters a variety of personalities, all with unique strengths. The individuals she works with span the corporate spectrum, from seasoned veterans seeking a fresh direction to emerging leaders eager to make their mark. Unearthing those strengths involves asking lots of great questions to get to the heart of what sets each leader apart.

programme.desc: We’re sitting down with a Luminary honoree to explore this year’s theme—Our Time, Our Way, Our Power—and to reveal how she’s succeeding on her own terms. programme.title: 2023 Women of Power Luminary Awards Luncheon

Hosts: Kristin Graves, Social Media Manager, BLACK ENTERPRISE Jeroslyn Johnson, Writer, BLACK ENTERPRISE The Luminary Awardees: Luvvie Ajayi Jones, Writer, Speaker, Multimedia Entrepreneur Issa Rae, Producer; Writer, Director Lauren Simmons, Wolfette of Wall Street

programme.title: Deliver the Performance of Your Life Hosted by Toyota
programme.desc: Hype coach and confidence activator KJ Rose will help you tap into your gifts and maximize your voice to push beyond your perceived capacity. Facilitator: Keanna “KJ Rose” Henson, Author, Artist Development & Performance Director; Founder, The Rose Effect, LLC

programme.title: Unlock the Secrets to Selling Successfully to Women
programme.desc: Whether in business settings or personal relationships, communication is a critical skill for men and women alike. For women, being genuinely heard by a man can be the difference between smooth conversations and blow-up arguments. And for men who can communicate effectively with women, it can be a game-changer in personal and professional relationships. Join Ramon Ray, ZoneofGenius.com and Sulonda Smith, founder of Crystal Clear Consultations for this powerful discussion.

programme.title: Diversifying Your Revenue Streams
programme.desc: Kathy Mason founded a real estate brokerage before expanding into construction and, most recently, into agricultural spaces with a 40-acre farm and event venue

programme.title: Don't Try to Hide Personal from Business on Social Media
programme.desc: Many business owners ask if they can post personal and business on social media. YES, it's good to share your personal life, to some degree on your business oriented social media. However, if you're trying to have something "hidden" then don't. Share things you don't want anyone to see on restricted platforms like What's App. Twitter(X) changed it's blocked user settings, to allow people to see your posts, even though you've blocked them. Other things covered on The Rundown with Ramon include: -Evaluating business idea viability -Seth Godin's writing advice on brevity -LinkedIn's AI job recruitment tools -Oura Smart Ring review -Health considerations for entrepreneurs over 40 -Hard vs. soft luggage debate -Making meaningful professional connections -Twitter/X's blocking feature update -Building startups while maintaining mental health

programme.title: How Follow-Up, Referrals, and Technology Help Service-Based Businesses
programme.desc: Matt Feierstein, president of Ever Commerce, speaks about the power of getting new customers, follow-ups, and referrals and leveraging technology to enhance and grow your business. He discusses this with Ramon Ray, publisher of ZoneofGenius.com

programme.title: Being Intentional: Navigating Business, Purpose, and Consistency
programme.desc: No matter what kind of business you want to start, you must be intentional with every step. That's a lesson Justin Konikow, a prominent real estate broker and media producer in southwestern Ontario, Canada, has learned through his ventures in the real estate industry. Justin shared insights into his path, highlighting the role of being intentional in personal and professional aspects of life to get where he is today. Continue watching to learn more about how to be intentional with every step.

programme.desc: Actress/comedian Jonica Booth talks about the character arc of Chastity on Issa Rae's "Rap Sh*t" and how reality television and standup comedy helped prepare her transition into acting.

programme.title: Diversifying Fashion for the Next Generation
programme.desc: Shaw Bernard, founder of Black-owned, woman-owned agency STRUT Models, is building a more inclusive industry one model at a time

programme.title: How To Build Generational Wealth Starting with Your Children
programme.desc: Hey everyone! Today we're diving into an eye-opening conversation with Holly Reid, CEO of The Master Playbook. Holly's on a mission to help families and business owners build lasting wealth and leave a powerful legacy. In this interview with Ramon Ray, publisher of ZoneofGenius.com, key takeaways from our chat included: 1. Legacy building isn't just for the ultra-rich. It's about creating value that lasts beyond your lifetime. 2. Forget complex financial jargon - Holly focuses on mindset shifts to kickstart your wealth journey. 3. Resistance from family members? Holly offers tips to address concerns and highlight the positive impact of increased wealth. 4. We discuss the importance of preparing your business for unexpected events. Holly shared a personal story that really drives this point home. 5. Action steps you can take today: Adopt a "legacy builder mentality," invest in yourself and your community, and start documenting your business assets properly. Holly's company, The Master Playbook, is all about empowering the next generation to master money. Whether you're a parent or a business owner, her insights can help you create a lasting financial impact. Remember, as Holly says, "Legacy isn't built on intention alone. You have to take intentional action." So let's get out there and start building our financial legacies!

programme.desc: Kellie Bowman, daughter of the late Dr. Sebi, owner of Sebi’s Daughters LLC, and celebrity nurse, is a passionate advocate for holistic health practices that can truly transform lives. With a profound understanding of the mind-body connection passed down from her father, Kellie offers a unique blend of insights that can empower informed choices for holistic well-being. programme.title: How To Build Trust and Confidence Within Yourself
programme.desc: Every entrepreneur aspires to cultivate confidence and trust in their professional relationships. Whether interacting with customers, employees, or colleagues, establishing a foundation of trust is essential for lasting success. But what if we told you that building a significant level of trust begins within? In a recent interview with Ramon Ray, Glen Gould, a former golf professional turned entrepreneur, author, and speaker, shared valuable insights on this topic. Continue watching to learn more from the interview, lessons learned, and strategies for fostering internal trust and confidence.

programme.title: Embracing Courageous Leadership
programme.desc: Starting and running a business can be frightening even for the bravest among us. It takes a special kind of grit to face the uncertainties and challenges you encounter on the road to startup. Recently, Ramon Ray chatted with Lisa Blackmon, Esquire — aka Lisa B, the Life Changer — about how crucial courage is for business leaders. Lisa, who helps individuals become more courageous leaders, has a background in law and over 25 years of experience in running her own business. In this article, we'll dig into Lisa's insights, giving straightforward tips for entrepreneurs to be brave leaders and enhance their skills.

programme.title: Unlocking LinkedIn Audio: A Conversation with Shameka Brathwaite
programme.desc: Whether you’re a startup entrepreneur pursuing your passions or a seasoned corporate professional seeking networking opportunities, LinkedIn is a go-to resource you won’t want to overlook. The platform is constantly evolving to provide innovative avenues for connection and collaboration. One such groundbreaking feature is LinkedIn Audio Events — a platform that allows creators to host live, interactive conversations with a global audience. To explore LinkedIn Audio’s capabilities, Ramon Ray sat down with Shameka Brathwaite, a leadership productivity expert and prominent user of this platform. Below, we explore best practices and tips on making the most of LinkedIn Audio and avoiding common pitfalls.

programme.title: Two Can Play That Game
programme.desc: Corporate attorney and relationship expert Shante Smith uses her rules for romance to keep her boyfriend in line. When he threatens to stray, she employs her ten-day plan to regain control, but his best friend counters with his own dating strategies in this battle of sexes.

programme.title: Mr. 3000
programme.desc: Aging baseball legend Stan Ross discovers that three of his 3,000 career hits were incorrectly counted. Nine years after retiring, the arrogant player returns to baseball at age 47 to reclaim his record and legacy while learning humility and what truly matters.

programme.title: All About The Benjamins
programme.desc: Bounty hunter Bucum Jackson teams with small-time con artist Reggie Wright, the man he's been pursuing, to locate missing diamonds and a lottery ticket worth millions. The unlikely partners race against criminals in this action-comedy about money, survival, and unexpected friendship.

programme.title: Next Friday
programme.desc: To escape neighborhood bully Deebo, Craig moves to the suburbs to live with his uncle and cousin Day-Day. What should be a peaceful change becomes complicated when they encounter new troubles including thieves, romantic interests, and neighborhood conflicts in Rancho Cucamonga.

programme.title: Love & Basketball
programme.desc: Childhood friends Monica and Quincy both aspire to professional basketball careers. Over eleven years, their paths intertwine as they navigate their passionate relationship alongside their athletic ambitions, learning that love requires the same dedication and sacrifice as sports.

programme.title: BlacKkKlansman
programme.desc: Based on a true story, Ron Stallworth becomes the first African-American detective in Colorado Springs Police Department. In the 1970s, he successfully infiltrates the local Ku Klux Klan chapter with the help of a Jewish colleague, exposing their violent plans while maintaining his cover.

programme.title: What Men Want
programme.desc: Sports agent Ali Davis is passed over for a promotion in her male-dominated profession. After a mystic encounter gives her the ability to hear men's thoughts, she uses this power to succeed in her career and gain an edge, but learns unexpected lessons about relationships and herself.

programme.title: Death at a Funeral
programme.desc: A funeral ceremony descends into chaos when a mysterious stranger arrives with a shocking secret about the deceased. Family tensions, mistaken drug consumption, and unexpected revelations turn the somber occasion into an outrageous comedy of errors filled with embarrassing disasters.

programme.title: My Boss's Daughter
programme.desc: Tom accepts his boss's request to house-sit, hoping to get close to his boss's daughter whom he has a crush on. The evening spirals into disaster as parties, drugs, escaped animals, and unexpected guests turn his romantic opportunity into total chaos.

programme.title: Drillbit Taylor
programme.desc: Three high school freshmen hire a low-budget bodyguard to protect them from bullies. The man claiming to be a special ops veteran is actually a homeless con artist, but he develops genuine affection for the kids while teaching them to stand up for themselves.

programme.title: Friday After Next
programme.desc: Craig and Day-Day work as security guards at a local shopping mall on Christmas Eve. When a crooked Santa Claus robs their apartment, they must navigate holiday chaos, pursue the thief, and try to recover their stolen presents and rent money before it's too late.

programme.title: The Bachelor Weekend (The Stag)
programme.desc: An Irish groom's brother plans a hiking trip bachelor party with a no-women rule. When the groom's fiancée's brother shows up with his girlfriend, tensions arise. The weekend camping trip becomes a test of friendships, masculinity, and relationships in the wilderness.

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Film noir-obsessed video store clerk Neil meets and falls for Violet, a free-spirited woman who pulls him into her world of spontaneous adventures. She stages elaborate film-like scenarios to shake up his routine life, but her extreme methods test whether their romance can survive reality.

programme.title: Two Can Play That Game
programme.desc: Corporate attorney and relationship expert Shante Smith uses her rules for romance to keep her boyfriend in line. When he threatens to stray, she employs her ten-day plan to regain control, but his best friend counters with his own dating strategies in this battle of sexes.

programme.title: Brown Sugar
programme.desc: Best friends Sidney and Dre share a lifelong love of hip-hop music. As they navigate their careers in the music industry—she as a magazine editor, he as a record executive—they must confront whether their deep connection is just friendship or something more romantic.

programme.desc: Hopeless romantic Tom Hansen works at a greeting card company and falls for Summer, a woman who doesn't believe in true love. The nonlinear narrative follows 500 days of their relationship as Tom reflects on where things went wrong after she unexpectedly dumps him.

programme.title: Fruitvale Station
programme.desc: Based on the true story of Oscar Grant's last day, January 1, 2009. The 22-year-old Bay Area resident celebrates New Year's Eve with family and friends before a confrontation with police at Fruitvale BART station leads to his tragic death, sparking national outrage.

programme.title: The Great Debaters
programme.desc: Based on a true story, professor Melvin B. Tolson inspires students at historically black Wiley College to form a debate team in 1930s Texas. They challenge racial prejudice and inequality, ultimately competing against Harvard University in a groundbreaking championship match.

programme.title: Take This Waltz
programme.desc: Margot, a happily married woman, develops an intense attraction to her charming neighbor Daniel. She struggles between comfortable marriage and passionate desire, exploring themes of commitment, longing, and whether giving in to temptation will bring happiness or destroy everything.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Eight: Perspective and Peace: Embracing Gratitude
programme.desc: In this episode of 'Pardon My Peace,' Danielle and Shay dive into a thought-provoking discussion about the significance of perspective in our lives. They explore the difference between needs and wants, sharing personal stories and reflecting on how our mindset shapes our appreciation for what we have. The conversation touches on topics like Southern California's unpredictable weather, the desire for new possessions, and the impact of modern society on our perceptions of adequacy. Danielle challenges herself and the listeners to differentiate between 'needs' and 'wants,' emphasizing gratitude and contentment. The episode encourages listeners to reflect on their own lives, offering humorous anecdotes and real-life examples to drive home the message of intentional living and genuine self-reflection.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Eleven: The Weight of a Mother's Faith Our Sickle Cell Testimony Part One
programme.desc: In this heartfelt episode of Pardon My Peace, Danielle shares the moving story of her son, Thomas Parker III, who was born with sickle cell disease. She recounts Parker's birth experience, early health challenges, and the emotional journey from initial diagnosis to ongoing care. With faith, determination, and a strong support system, Danielle navigates the complexities of raising a child with chronic illness, while ensuring he leads a fulfilling life. This episode provides a deep look into the resilience and love that drive a mother's commitment to her child’s well-being.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Five: Empowerment in Solitude: Date Yourself!
programme.desc: In this episode of 'Pardon My Peace,' Danielle and Shay discuss the concept of 'dating yourself.' They explore personal experiences and the benefits of taking time for self-care and doing things solo. The conversation touches on growing confidence, the importance of self-love, and how societal expectations often make such practices challenging. Whether you're single, in a relationship, or a busy mom, they share insights on how to make time for yourself and why it's essential for overall well-being. Tune in for an inspiring discussion on normalizing self-dates, building confidence, and celebrating individuality.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Four: DEA Busts, Fiery Conversations, and Dating Dilemmas
programme.desc: In this episode of 'Pardon My Piece,' hosts Danielle and Shay dive into a lively discussion filled with personal stories and reflections. Filmed during an evening session, they explore topics such as the hosts' preference for nighttime energy, the nap debate, memorable college experiences, and the cultural differences in substance use. They also touch on the impact of natural disasters like California fires, the importance of healthy eating, and Shay's personal revelation about her dating life and the importance of shooting your shot. It's a candid conversation that offers a mix of humor, nostalgia, and genuine advice.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Nine: Fun Facts and True Friendship: How Well Do You Know Me?
programme.desc: Join Danielle and Shay in an engaging and hilarious episode of 'Pardon My Peace' as they dive into a series of personal questions in the game 'How Well Do You Know Me?'. Watch as they share fun facts about each other, discuss their pet peeves, dream jobs, favorite foods, and recall childhood memories. With lots of laughter and heartfelt moments, this episode offers an entertaining way to learn more about these two friends. Take a seat with the ladies and join the Group Chat You Didn't Know You Needed. Don't forget to leave your questions and comments below!

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode One: The Danielle Interview
programme.desc: In this episode, we delve into personal reflections and experiences, including Danielle's journey of self-discovery apart from her roles as a wife and mother. We also discuss overcoming fears and insecurities, such as body dysmorphia, and the ways personal growth shapes our lives. Danielle shares how her son's battle with sickle cell disease strengthened her faith and relationship with God. Join us for honest conversations and a dose of authenticity.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Seven: Unpacking the Burden: Should Women Fix Men?
programme.desc: In this episode, Shay and Danielle dive into the complex topic of whether it's a woman's job to fix a broken man. They discuss their perspectives on emotional intelligence, healing, and the importance of self-improvement in relationships. They touch on societal expectations, gender norms, and the significance of therapy for both men and women. Join in on this deep and meaningful conversation and share your thoughts in the comments. Don't forget to like, subscribe, and follow for more insightful discussions!

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Six: Exploring Femininity: Softness, Strength, and Everything In Between
programme.desc: Join us as we dive into a candid discussion about femininity, challenging traditional notions and exploring what it truly means. We share personal stories, insights, and tips on embracing and celebrating feminine energy. This episode also addresses common misconceptions, highlights the importance of self-awareness and self-care, and offers practical advice to enhance your connection with your inner feminine energy. Whether you're looking to redefine femininity for yourself or simply curious about different perspectives, this episode is for you. Don't forget to like, subscribe, and share your thoughts in the comments!

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Ten: The Friendship Spectrum: From Daily Chats to Timeless Bonds
programme.desc: In this heartfelt episode, Danielle and Shay reflect on personal experiences, discussing the differences between high maintenance and low maintenance friendships. They share a gripping story of a near-miss scare involving Danielle's son, Declan, emphasizing the importance of staying calm in emergencies. The conversation delves into the dynamics of friendships, introversion, extroversion, and the need for self-care. Explore how knowing oneself and others can lead to more meaningful and balanced relationships. Join us for an insightful chat on thriving in both extroverted and introverted spaces without losing oneself!

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Three: Marriage: Commitment, Paper, or Both?
programme.desc: In this heartfelt episode of 'Pardon My Peace,' Danielle interviews her close friend Shay. They discuss Shay's journey to finding faith, the significance of family, and the most important relationships in her life, particularly with her father. The episode also explores their rekindled friendship after years of separation, showcasing the power of honesty, growth, and forgiveness. Shay shares her passions, life lessons, and dreams, making this an inspirational story not just about friendship but also about self-discovery and resilience. Don't miss this authentic conversation filled with humor, love, and real talk. In this episode of Pardon My Peace, hosts Shay and Danielle dive into the thought-provoking topic of whether marriage is overrated. They explore both sides of the debate, discussing how societal views on marriage have evolved over time and the various reasons people choose to get married today. The conversation covers the challenges of maintaining a long-term commitment, the evolving roles of women, and the importance of personal happiness and growth within a marriage. Danielle shares insights from her decade-long marriage, while Shay contemplates her own views on the institution. Tune in for an honest, candid discussion about love, commitment, and the evolving nature of marriage in modern society.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Twelve: The Weight of a Mother's Faith Our Sickle Cell Testimony Part Two
programme.desc: In this heartfelt episode, we explore the inspiring story of Parker, a young boy who battled sickle cell disease and braved the challenges of a bone marrow transplant during the COVID-19 pandemic. His mother shares the emotional and complex journey from early hour shopping to avoid exposure, Parker contracting COVID-19, and the intensive bone marrow transplant process. Discover how Parker's resilience, family support, and their steadfast faith led to his miraculous recovery. This episode delves into the medical, emotional, and spiritual aspects of their experience, highlighting the critical role of testimonies and the importance of becoming an advocate for others facing similar challenges.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Two: The Shay interview
programme.desc: In this heartfelt episode of 'Pardon My Peace,' Danielle interviews her close friend Shay. programme.title: To Cut
programme.desc: A biographical documentary that tells the inspiring story of Stuart Linder, a prominent American plasticsurgeon. Once deterred by his teachers from pursuing medical practices, now one of the most sough after professionals in practice.

programme.title: Viral
programme.desc: Unable to come to terms with the death of his brother by the hands of a police officer, Quincy is pushed to face his emotions and navigate his new reality. In doing so, he is presented with an opportunity to seek justice in an unconventional way.

programme.title: Xavier
programme.desc: A biographical documentary short that tells the story of a chance meeting of social media peronality Blake Linder and cancer warrior Xavier Mejias. This visual challenges audiences to reach for higher levels of compassion, selflessness, mentorship and gratefulness while begging the question "are you truly connecting with people on social media".

programme.title: All My Friends Are Robots
programme.desc: After one brother clicks a strange hyperlink, two siblings must battle their best friend—now transformed into a relentless humanoid—before the glitch consumes them all.

programme.title: Ashes To Ashes
programme.desc: When Xavier unexpectedly receives the ashes of his dead father in the mail, he is forced to confront a lifetime of daddy issues.

programme.title: Below Watson's
programme.desc: Beneath the charm of Watson’s Soda Fountain and Café on East Chapman Avenue in Orange, California, lies a mystery sealed in brick and shadow. Once a bustling drug store and diner during the Prohibition era, the café is said to sit above a hidden network of tunnels that have long been blocked from public view. Were these tunnels a lifeline, a smuggling route—or something far more dangerous? This documentary highlights the community that whispers about the layers of history, chasing the echoes of footsteps that may never have wanted to be found.

programme.title: Candles
programme.desc: In this short psychological thriller, a seemingly grieveing and sinister teen boy. Is his therapist an emotional anchor? Or is she someone quite sinister herself?

programme.title: Chick Bait
programme.desc: In this lighthearted comedy, a lonely, overweight man just wants to enjoy a quiet afternoon and his baskin robbins Ice cream. But his simple pleasure takes a wild turn when a mischievous dachshund waddles up, steals his sweet trea. the man tries to shoo the dog away, but fate has other plans. A charming young woman notices the adorable thief and mistakes the man for its doting owner. Suddenly thrust into an unexpected role, he finds himself sharing laughs and lunch with her, daydreaming that maybe, just maybe, this accident could lead to love. But just as the sparks begin to flicker, disaster strikes. The real owner appears, frantic and furious at finding the “lost” dog in the man’s company. A story of ice cream, mistaken identity, and a very determined little dog.

programme.title: Dream To Sell
programme.desc: A biographical documentary that tells the inspiring rags to riches story of Simon Sarradine, a prominent American with lebanese ancestry. Once a struggling boy, now the king of a motor-vehicle empire, who continues to dream bigger.

programme.title: Father Figure
programme.desc: Richard kidnaps his two children, consumed by resentment toward his ex-wife, Diana, and convinced that only he can provide them a safe home. But as his desperation grows, Richard's obsessive need for control begins to expose the monstrous reflection of his own flaws. Meanwhile, their fractured family becomes the target of the Father Figure-a sinister entity that preys on children from broken, unstable homes. When the demon abducts the children, Richard is forced to face the consequences of his destructive choices and the darker truths about himself. Now, he must confront the ultimate evil to save his children, before his mistakes doom him forever.
